rationale: Roberts is best positioned to hold the 7-Justice coalition together with a narrow standing discussion and a statutory merits holding that the HEROES Act does not clearly authorize mass principal cancellation, with major-questions clear-statement reasoning in the background. Separate writings are most likely from Thomas/Alito/Gorsuch to sharpen separation-of-powers/major-questions themes and from Sotomayor/Jackson to dissent on standing and jurisdictional restraint.
